scope: Julia allocation samples from after owner preparation through loop exit; includes initial unmeasured run, bootstrap waiting and control queries; frame category matches named processing/adoption stack functions, other is not fully attributed; excludes native C/Rust allocator and post-stop writer
timestamp_scope: Profile timestamp values retained raw; not asserted to be nanoseconds or aligned with callback clock
timing_scope: Diagnostic capture only; timing excluded from ordinary comparisons
positive_control: allocation-writer-positive-control.jl detects deliberately introduced frame and parameter-preparation allocations
